input.title: Give the quantity field the accessible name "Quantity"
input.rationale:
The number input #qty has no accessible name. The "Quantity" label on line 11 sits next to it but isn't linked: it has no for="qty" and doesn't wrap the input. Screen readers announce the field only as a spin button with no name.

I can only edit the flagged input, so this patch adds aria-label="Quantity". That matches the visible label word for word, so speech-input users can still say "Quantity" to reach the field.

A better fix, which I can't make here, is to add for="qty" to the <label> on line 11. That links them in the markup, and clicking the label also moves focus to the field. If you make that change, you can remove this aria-label. Please test with a screen reader to confirm the field is now announced as "Quantity". This patch doesn't make the page fully accessible.
